executionBoundary: One four-CPU Linux job containing shared prerequisite and parallel consumer branches; not a distributed cross-job artifact DAG or whole-repository pipeline
cachePolicy: No explicit repository package/compiler cache restoration or prepared snapshot; provider image/tool/registry caches are observed rather than assumed absent
sourceGuardBoundary: All frozen top-level Git entries except declared .github/.depot research configuration, plus tracked working-tree diff; generated research helper and build outputs are identified separately
